summary: validate-modules codes for invalid required_one_of, required_together and required_if entries: non-string values, repeated terms, unknown options, and wrong requirement or is_one_of types.
questions: Why is my required_together entry flagged?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (required_*)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `required_one_of-*` / `required_together-*`: `-type` (non-string), `-collision` (repeated), `-unknown` (not in argument_spec, maybe an alias)
- `required_if-is_one_of-type`: 4th value must be bool
- `required_if-requirements-type`: 3rd value must be list/tuple
- `required_if-requirements-collision` / `-unknown`
- `required_if-unknown-key`: key not in argument_spec
